description:
My playbook for growing a $1M AI agency: https://app.aiautomationsociety.ai/opaa-ads-optin
My FREE resources: https://www.skool.com/ai-automation-society/about?el=saas-2-hour-course&hcategory=youtube-videos&utm_campaign=free-group

My Tools💻
FREE MONTH voice to text: https://get.glaido.com/nate
Code NATEHERK for 10% off VPS (annual plan): https://www.hostinger.com/vps/claude-code-hosting

I built an AI SaaS product in one day, starting with no idea at all. You'll see the whole run: research agents scanning 60,000+ comments to find a real pain point, the branding and waitlist page, the app itself with Supabase auth and Stripe subscriptions, a security review that caught four high-severity release blockers, and a live domain at the end. 

Then I go over what happens after the build, such as getting your first 50 customers, pricing without guessing, and why I'd pay small creators before putting a dollar into ads. If you've been sitting on an idea, this should show you how much of it you can actually do yourself.

Sponsorship Inquiries:
📧 nate@smoothmedia.co

Connect with me:
https://www.linkedin.com/in/nateherkelman/
https://x.com/nateherk
https://www.instagram.com/nateherk/
